name: scoped-lint-never-reaches-implementation
body: A scoped `lint` run selects only the named tier and the more abstract tiers above it in the catalog ladder, so the implementation and global layers are never in scope and R3/R4, note confinement and the constraint body checks can only report on an unscoped run; the ladder tops out at Solution. Upgrade if a tiered run should also check notes or constraints — that needs a new `--tier` value (parse_lint_args currently refuses implementation/global as usage errors) and a ladder that reaches past Solution.
